summary: Tested deal fetching and auto-publish. New pytest file: 6/6 passed. Public /api/public/deals returns 115-117 published deals and all have publication_status=published. POST /cron/tick without auth or with a wrong token returns 401. With WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET it returns 202 in 0.13s with {queued:true,sources:40}. A second tick while a scan is running returns 202 {queued:false,running:true}. Total went from 115 to 116 after the scan. The auto_publish setting defaults to true, toggles to false, persists, and was restored to true. A manual deal (post_now:false) is saved as a draft and is not public. Publish and unpublish through /review work. UI on desktop 1920: 117 cards. Category tabs work (best 15, supercoin 0, gift 1, price drops 107, gold 9, lowest 16, starred 0). Search 'gold' gives 10 results. A search with no match shows 'No offers match your search.' Mobile 390: 0px horizontal overflow. In Admin, the Rules switch rule-auto-publish-switch starts ON. Toggling it off and saving persists through API and reload, and it was restored to ON. The Sources tab lists 40 sources and shows errors: desidime web x2 'HTTP 403', and tapworthy and hotdealsbywd 'public web preview' turned off. The nitter 404 had cleared by the latest scan: no nitter source has last_error now. In the Deals tab, Review & edit then 'Save as draft' unpublished a TEST published fixture, which then disappeared from public /deals. INTERMITTENT: 2 of about 10 home page loads stayed stuck on 'Loading offers...' because Vite dev modules (tailwind-merge.js, react-router useSearch.js) returned 503. Hydration failed and the deals never loaded. Deals are fetched only on the client, not server-rendered. It could not be reproduced afterwards: 0 errors in 5 loads with cache disabled, and the modules and API stayed 200 during a running scan. So it is probably preview edge or dev-server flakiness, not the scan blocking.

minor.issue: Auto-published deals never write price_history; only review.server saveReview does. The collection has 1 row for about 116 published deals, so the price-history panel and the lowest-observed history are empty for fetched deals.
Unpublishing still requires a title of 8-180 characters. A fetched deal with a short title cannot be unpublished until its title is edited.

The 2 desidime.com website sources always fail with HTTP 403. The desidime and dealsmagnet website sources point at single-deal URLs (e.g. /deals/100-supercoin-back-on-2193106), not listing pages, so they add little.

ui_bugs.issue: Intermittent (about 20% right after the frontend restart; 0% later): a dev module returns 503, hydration fails, and 'Loading offers...' stays forever with no retry or error state. Deals are not server-rendered.

issues: The panel says 'Sources are checked automatically every 15 minutes' but the 'Check for deals every' select shows '5 minutes' (stats check_interval_seconds=300). The two contradict each other.
The 'Max deals posted per update' help says 'Unreviewed deals remain private drafts', which is wrong while auto-publish is ON.
The subtitle 'Imported deals stay private until reviewed', the 'Import drafts' button and the 'N drafts imported' labels are out of date now that auto-publish is ON.
Many sources still show raw host names (e.g. 'nitter.mie.foundation' x several, 'desidime.com (website)' x2), so they are hard to tell apart.
The review queue says 'Drafts are private...' and unpublishing is done with the 'Save as draft' button. An explicit 'Unpublish' label would be clearer.

Some auto-published cards are raw promo posts, e.g. 'The Kalyan Jewellers gold deal is now OUT OF STOCK ... Join', which comes with auto-publish. Some cards use a letter placeholder instead of an image.

action_items: Make the home deals list robust: server-render the deals with a route loader, or add an error and retry state, so a failed client fetch or hydration does not leave 'Loading offers...' forever.
Record price_history when ingest auto-publishes a deal, as saveReview does.
Bring the admin copy in line with auto-publish (Sources subtitle, 'Import drafts', 'drafts imported', the 'Max deals' help), and fix the 15-minute vs 5-minute check interval wording.
Optional: allow unpublishing (publish:false) without enforcing the title length; drop or disable the desidime website sources that return 403; skip 'OUT OF STOCK' posts when ingesting.
critical_code_review_comments: core.server.ts is 891 lines, over the 700-line threshold.
verifyCronRequest also accepts the secret in the ?key= query string, so it can leak into access logs. Prefer header-only.
addDeal defaults post_now to true and calls postDeal for a draft manual deal. Check that postDeal itself refuses drafts; only repost() checks publication_status.
router.server.ts handles cron/fetch twice (GET and POST); only tick is needed for the scheduler.
seed_data_creation: None kept. Created a TEST_manual draft through the API, deleted by id. Inserted the TEST_unpub_ui_01 published fixture into the DB and deleted it by id. auto_publish was restored to true. 3 cron ticks ran real scans, which added about 2 real deals (expected behaviour).
context_for_next_testing_agent: 40 real sources and about 117 real published deals; do not delete them. The scheduler is webhook-crond (crons.yml, every 15 minutes) calling POST /api/public/cron/tick. Use post_now:false when creating manual deals. Unpublish in the UI: Deals tab, review-open-{id}, then review-draft-{id}. If the home page sticks on 'Loading offers...', look for 503s on /node_modules/.vite modules.
